programmes.d: Sarah makes a bargain with the Spider Queen and returns to Earth with the Doctor.
The Doctor returns to Metebelis 3 where he must face the spider's ruler, the Great One.
UNIT are called in when top secret plans are stolen from high security establishments.
Harry Sullivan is sent to infiltrate Think Tank to discover the truth.
Sealed inside an underground bunker, Miss Winters issues her demands to the world.
The Doctor races to avert a nuclear holocaust. The robot takes Sarah hostage.
The survivors of Earth lie in hibernation, but the Doctor finds there has been an intruder.
The Doctor is worried because the survivors of the human race are beginning to wake up.
Humankind faces total destruction. Can the Doctor defeat the Wirrn?
Trapped by the Wirrn, The Doctor and his friends are forced into one last terrible gamble.
Arriving on Earth, the Doctor, Harry and Sarah meet a group of stranded human colonists.
Sarah has been captured by Styre who is conducting experiments on the captured humans.
The Time Lords send the Doctor, Sarah and Harry to a time shortly before the creation of the Daleks.
The Doctor finds that some of Davros's fellow Kaleds are unhappy with the development of the Daleks.
The Doctor informs the Kaled government of Davros's experiments, and they move to shut down the bunker.
When the Kaled dome is destroyed, the war appears to be over and the Thals rejoice at their victory.
Davros interrogates the Doctor, forcing him to reveal the future of the Daleks.
The Kaled elite move to prevent the development of the Daleks while the Doctor hopes to destroy them forever.
The Doctor, Sarah and Harry return to Nerva, but at an earlier point in time.
Sarah is the latest victim of the space plague.
The Cybermen who are intent on destroying Voga.
Their plan to blow up Voga thwarted, the Cybermen intend to crash Nerva into the planet.
The Doctor returns to discover what is destroying oil rigs off the coast of Scotland.
Sarah is attacked by a Zygon disguised as Harry who is a prisoner on the Zygon spaceship.
The Doctor and Sarah find their way into the Zygon spaceship at the bottom of Loch Ness.
Broton, the Zygon warlord, intends to use the Skarasen to attack London.
The TARDIS takes the Doctor and Sarah to Zeta Minor on the edge of the universe.
The Doctor and Sarah are held responsible for the deaths on Zeta Minor.
In the universe of antimatter, the Doctor communes with the creature and makes a bargain.
On board the Morestran ship, the Doctor and Sarah are hemmed in by anti-men!
The Doctor and Sarah discover that an ancient and powerful evil is manifesting on Earth.
The Doctor, Sarah and Laurence Scarman are being hunted down by Sutekh's robot mummies.
The mummies are building a rocket to fire at the pyramid on Mars and release Sutekh.
Inside the pyramid on Mars, the Doctor and Sarah must prevent Sutekh's release.

The TARDIS arrives back on Earth but all is not as it seems.
The Doctor discovers the truth behind the village and its robot population.
The Kraals intend to invade Earth by stowing away aboard Crayford's rocket as it returns home.
The Doctor and Sarah are desperate to warn UNIT of the Kraal's invasion, but nobody will believe them.
The Doctor and Sarah take shelter in the castle of Dr Solon on the planet Karn.
The Doctor is a prisoner of the Sisterhood of Karn who plan to burn him at the stake.
Morbius demands that Solon install his brain in a new body.
The Doctor challenges Morbius to a mental duel in which only one of them will survive.
The Doctor learns of the discovery of two alien seed pods in the Antarctic.
The Krynoid is on the loose in the Arctic.
The Doctor and Sarah track down the remaining Krynoid pod.
Keeler has been infected by the alien pod and is transforming into a Krynoid.
The Krynoid demands that the Doctor be surrendered to it.
The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase.
The TARDIS flies into the Mandragora Helix, an alien energy in space.
The Doctor is making enemies of the Court Astrologer Hieronymous.
